name: Being Ignored
overview: Scripture acknowledges the experience of being ignored or rejected, emphasizing reliance on the Lord as our shepherd who provides and sustains (Psalms 23:1). Believers are encouraged not to fret over the actions of evildoers or envy those who disregard God's ways (Psalms 37:1), but to seek God's help and judgment in times of distress (Psalms 54:1). The consequences of rejecting divine knowledge are severe, leading to destruction and separation from God's blessings (Hosea 4:6). Jesus warns against offering what is holy to those who will not appreciate it, highlighting the importance of discernment in sharing spiritual truths (Matthew 7:6), and stresses the necessity of obedience to His teachings to avoid a foundation of folly (Matthew 7:26). Together, these verses counsel believers to trust God amid neglect, pursue His wisdom, and wisely steward His truth.
